name: Fast Favor
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECTS

Range personal
Target you
Duration see text

You draw upon the power of your domain in order to gain a very brief advantage or other sort of assistance.

The exact nature of this assistance varies with each domain. Unless otherwise mentioned in the individual descriptions assume that the duration of this advantage lasts until used or the start of your next turn; whichever happens first.
